args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled_out. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy: false` and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest production deploy and was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as `rolled_out` across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api, documenting the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and that root cause investigation is ongoing. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: I did not deploy v2.3.1-rc (the staging candidate) since it was also unhealthy in staging, and the task was to roll back to the last healthy production release.
